qualitative.equivalence_statement_raw: A university degree that led to the acquisition of 210 ECTS credits is required. This admission requirement is considered fulfilled if a university degree that led to the acquisition of 180 ECTS credits has been completed, and an additional 30 ECTS credits have been acquired according to § 7 (1) or (2). The university degree must have been completed with a minimum overall grade of 2.5 on the grading system used at Hof University or an equivalent grading system. Alternatively, a minimum grade of 3.0 or an equivalent grade is sufficient if special achievements have demonstrated competencies that are at least equivalent to those required in the previous sentence. Special achievements in this sense include, in particular, studies abroad or relevant professional experience. The university degree must have been in a business or economics study program. A university degree in another study program is considered equivalent if modules for the acquisition of economics/business competencies totaling 30 ECTS credits have been completed according to § 7 (2) Satz 2.
core_reference_pillars: Ability to discuss possible future developments

contingencies.notes: If the qualifying bachelor's degree was 180 ECTS, an additional 30 ECTS must be acquired as a 'Nachqualifikation' according to § 7 (1) or (2) to reach 210 ECTS. If the qualifying bachelor's degree was not in a business or economics study program, 30 ECTS in economics/business competencies must be completed according to § 7 (2) Satz 2.
